b4_text_layer_sanitized:
48
If the plates of a parallel plate capacitor connected to a battery are moved close to each other, then
A. the charge stored in it, increases. B. the energy stored in it, decreases. C. its capacitance
increases. D. the ratio of charge to its potential remains the same. E. the product of charge and
voltage increases. Choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
(1)
A, B and E only
(2)
A, C and E only
(3)
B, D and E only
(4)
A, B and C only
Electrostatic Potential and Capacitance

b4_script_options.4:
A, B and C only
Electrostatic Potential and Capacitance

subject: Physics
b6_reason: With the battery attached V is fixed, so smaller d raises C, hence Q = CV and QV both rise; A, C and E are true while B and D are false.
b6_working: C = eps0*A/d increases as d decreases (C true). Q = CV increases (A true). U = (1/2)CV^2 increases, so 'energy decreases' is false (B false). Q/V = C increases, so it does not stay the same (D false). QV = CV^2 increases (E true). Hence A, C and E.
